description: This header defines interfaces related to warning reporting, including warning events and reporting control mechanisms for the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event objects, including serialization, deserialization, categorization, and warning identification.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units which can report events and manage categories.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Interface for controlling warning category settings, supports exclusion and configuration.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the warning reporting control object.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event identified by an string identifier.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific warning category, including default status, enabled state, exclusions, and configuration.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a warning category control to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a warning category control from the category list.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Excludes a specific warning category from reporting.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Applies configuration settings to a warning category.
